whyItMatters: Math.random() output is predictable once the seed state is known. Tokens, reset codes, or shuffle orders built on it can be guessed by an attacker who observes enough outputs.
actions: Use crypto.getRandomValues() (browser) or crypto.randomBytes()/randomInt() (Node) for security choices.
Keep Math.random() only for non-security uses such as games, sampling, and UI jitter.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm remaining DPK-SAST-013 hits are non-security uses.
verification: No security-sensitive code path still depends on Math.random() output.
